title: crotalaria multiflora var. kurisumalayana
intro: Crotalaria multiflora var. kurisumalayana, commonly known as Kurisumalayana or Kariyan, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in Ayurvedic medicine, where it is valued for its ability to promote overall well-being and alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Kurisumalayana include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Kurisumalayana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although specific information on these constituents may be limited.
